name: @mercatus-liber/auto-update
description: Reads a scaffolded store's mercatus-liber.config.json manifest, checks @mercatus-liber/* package versions against an injectable registry client, and applies updates only if the target project's own test suite still passes afterward -- rolling back otherwise. The auto-update half of the commercial thesis (epic deploy-tool-and-auto-update). Depends on @mercatus-liber/create-store's manifest module only.
